title: Traffic Stop Turns Into Woman's Worst Nightmare
description:
#news #police #arrest

On February 13, 2023. An officer conducted a traffic stop on a  woman whose vehicle had expired tags. When she stopped her vehicle, the lady immediately got out of the car and started acting strange. Upon further investigation, officers found out that the woman had an active warrant for her arrest. She was identified as Ashley.

police101watch@gmail.com

About us / Disclaimer:

Welcome to Police Watch! We offer an exclusive and authentic look into the world of law enforcement through the lens of body-worn cameras. Our channel provides raw and unfiltered footage of police officers in action, from routine traffic stops to high-stakes situations.
